name.quote: "Advisory board." The Accessibility Advisory Board created in section 106.

authority.value: The advisory board shall review all proposed regulations under this act and shall offer comment and advice to the secretary on all issues relating to accessibility by persons with physical disabilities; shall review applications for modifications; and shall review updated accessibility code sections and submit a report to the secretary.
authority.quote: The advisory board shall review all proposed regulations under this act and shall offer comment and advice to the secretary on all issues relating to accessibility by persons with physical disabilities, including those which relate to the enforcement of the accessibility requirements.

national_association.quote: The department, in consultation with the advisory board, ICC, NCSBCS and other interested parties, shall by regulation adopt a program of required training and certification for all categories of code administrators.

regulatory_model.quote: An individual certified by the Department of Labor and Industry in an appropriate category established pursuant to section 701(b) to perform plan review of construction documents, inspect construction or administer and enforce codes and regulations in such code category under this act or related acts.

credential_type.quote: Upon determination of qualification, the department shall issue a certificate to the code administrator stating that he is so certified.

is_mandatory.quote: Nothing in this act shall allow a municipality to prohibit a construction code official who meets the requirements of Chapter 7 and remains in good standing from performing inspections in the municipality.

title_protection.quote: "Construction code official." An individual certified by the Department of Labor and Industry in an appropriate category established pursuant to section 701(b) to perform plan review of construction documents, inspect construction or administer and enforce codes and regulations in such code category under this act or related acts.

scope_protection.quote: "Municipal code official." An individual employed by a municipality or more than one municipality and certified by the Department of Labor and Industry under this act to perform plan review of construction documents, inspect construction or administer and enforce codes and regulations under this act or related acts.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The department may decertify code administrators for just cause.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The department is empowered to decertify code administrators for just cause.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A code administrator shall not review or approve plans for any building or structure in which the code administrator has any financial interest.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A code administrator shall not review or approve any plans for or construction of any building or structure in which the code administrator has any financial interest.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Waivers for initial training and certification do not apply to continuing education requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any waiver shall not apply to continuing education requirements.

insurance_required.quote: The department shall promulgate regulations requiring code administrators in third-party agencies to carry minimum levels of liability insurance.

definition_quote.value: A code administrator is a municipal code official, a construction code official, a third-party agency or the Department of Labor and Industry.
definition_quote.quote: "Code administrator." A municipal code official, a construction code official, a third-party agency or the Department of Labor and Industry.

value: administer and enforce codes and regulations
methods_authorized.quote: to perform plan review of construction documents, inspect construction or administer and enforce codes and regulations in such code category under this act or related acts.

certification_categories.quote: The department, in consultation with the ICC and other interested parties, shall establish appropriate categories of code administrators.

decertification_authority.quote: The department is empowered to decertify code administrators for just cause.

certification_waiver_available.quote: The department shall by regulation establish a procedure for the consideration of requests for waivers of the initial training and certification requirements for individuals who present documentation that they have previously satisfied substantially similar training, testing and certification requirements.

remedial_education_authority.quote: The department is empowered to require code administrators to participate in remedial education programs for just cause.

third_party_agency_insurance_required.quote: The department shall promulgate regulations requiring code administrators in third-party agencies to carry minimum levels of liability insurance.

financial_interest_prohibition.quote: A code administrator shall not review or approve any plans for or construction of any building or structure in which the code administrator has any financial interest.

permit_application_decision_deadline_day.quote: Every application for a construction permit for one-family and two-family dwelling units and utility and miscellaneous use structures shall be granted or denied, in whole or in part, within 15 business days of the filing date

required_inspection_stages.quote: For one-family and two-family dwelling units and utility and miscellaneous use structures, all of the following five inspections shall be required: (i) Foundation inspection. (ii) Plumbing, mechanical and electrical inspection. (iii) Frame and masonry inspection. (iv) Wallboard inspection. (v) Final inspection.

deemed_approved_if_no_action.quote: If the code administrator fails to act on an application for a construction permit for one-family and two-family dwelling units and utility and miscellaneous use structures within the time prescribed, the application shall be deemed approved.

adopted_model_code.value: 1999 BOCA National Building Code, Fourteenth Edition (Uniform Construction Code); ICC International One and Two Family Dwelling Code, 1998 Edition
adopted_model_code.quote: The department shall, within 180 days of the effective date of this section, promulgate regulations adopting the 1999 BOCA National Building Code, Fourteenth Edition, as a Uniform Construction Code

state_preempts_local_codes.quote: construction standards provided by any statute or local ordinance or regulation promulgated or adopted by a board, department, commission, agency of State government or agency of local government shall continue in effect only until the effective date of regulations promulgated under this act, at which time they shall be preempted by regulations promulgated under this act and deemed thereafter to be rescinded.

municipality_may_exceed_minimum.quote: Municipalities may enact ordinances which equal or exceed the minimum requirements of Chapter 1 of the 1999 BOCA National Building Code, Fourteenth Edition, or successor codes, relating to administration consistent with the provisions of section 501(c).

value: retention of construction code officials or third-party agencies
enforcement_delivery_options.quote: This act may be administered and enforced by municipalities in any of the following ways: (1) By the designation of an employee to serve as the municipal code official ... (2) By the retention of one or more construction code officials or third-party agencies ... (3) Two or more municipalities may provide for the joint administration and enforcement ... (4) By entering into a contract with the proper authorities of another municipality ... (5) By entering into an agreement with the department

board_of_appeals_required.quote: A municipality which has adopted an ordinance for the administration and enforcement of this act or municipalities which are parties to an agreement for the joint administration and enforcement of this act shall establish or designate a board of appeals as provided by regulations promulgated by the department to hear appeals from decisions of the code administrator.

accessibility_advisory_board_exists.quote: There is hereby created an Accessibility Advisory Board which shall be composed of 11 members

accessibility_certification_required.quote: This education program shall include accessibility requirements contained in and referenced by the Uniform Construction Code.
